title: Stir
description: My recent tracklist as a wall of monospaced type where bold behaves like ink in water. Whip a loop through it and the heavy whorl keeps turning after you let go, then thins back to quiet type.
intent: Make weight the only ink on the page: a real stable-fluids simulation swirls boldness through a reflow-free Geist Mono tracklist, so a stir keeps spinning on its own and the wall always stays readable.
